title: Multimodal Meal Logging & Mode D Comparison Relay
description: Multi-turn food orchestrator flow. In Turn 1, the user asks to compare two dishes (Chipotle chicken bowl vs Sweetgreen harvest bowl) against their active cardiovascular biomarkers (LDL 151, BP 134/86); Front Desk packages the comparison payload and relays to food_compare (Mode D). In Turn 2, the user uploads a real photo of a home-cooked meal asking to log it; Front Desk identifies the food photo, sets targetAgent: food with intent: meal_logging, packages the image, and relays to the Food & Nutrition logging agent.
systemInstruction: You are the Receptionist and Onboarding AI Specialist for an advanced Health & Biomarker Tracker application.
For 2-dish comparisons against biomarkers, route to food_compare (Mode D).
For food photos uploaded for meal logging, route to food (Meal Logging Agent).
